title: [P2] feat: append-only events.jsonl + JSONL transcripts (stable observability contract)
body:
**Priority:** P2 — the enabler for any rich UI; additive only
**Lane:** `lib/status.mjs` + `lib/agy.mjs` log framing — sequence after `--watch`, before the TUI.

## Context

Two observability gaps block a rich dashboard (and make post-run analysis annoying):

1. **No event history.** `run.json` is a snapshot; past transitions are lost — a UI can only diff polls. All transitions already funnel through `status.ticket()` / `status.pools()` (`lib/scheduler.mjs:284-297`), so an append-only log is a small change at existing call sites.
2. **Transcripts use custom framing.** `.booster/logs/<runId>/<ticketId>.log` is a JSON header line + `\n---PROMPT---\n...\n---OUTPUT---\n...\n===\n`, appended across strikes (`lib/agy.mjs:86-91`). Tailing requires a bespoke parser.

## Task

1. `.booster/logs/<runId>/events.jsonl`: Add an `appendEvent(runId, event)` function to `lib/status.mjs` and export it. Have `lib/scheduler.mjs` call it directly to append one JSON line per transition from the same call sites. Schema: `{ ts, runId, type: 'phase'|'pool'|'strike'|'report', ticket?, from?, to?, detail?, pools? }`. For `phase` events, if `model`, `strikes`, or `detail` aren't in the transition patch, retrieve them from the ticket's current state so each event is self-contained. Use asynchronous `fs.appendFile` (fire-and-forget, non-blocking) instead of `appendFileSync` to avoid blocking the main scheduler event loop.
2. Normalize per-ticket transcripts to JSONL: one record per agy invocation `{ ts, model, strike, ms, ok, kind?, error, prompt, output }`. `error` must be completely omitted/undefined when `ok` is true. Move the existing header object's fields + the two text blocks into one JSON line. Name the file `<ticketId>.jsonl`. Ensure all agy invocations for a ticket (including prosecutor strikes) append to this same `<ticketId>.jsonl` file.
3. Document both schemas in `docs/usage.md` as a stable read contract for external tools.

**Contract Export:** `lib/status.mjs` will export `appendEvent(runId, event)`. Existing functions like `status.ticket()` maintain their original signatures.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every phase transition in a scheduler test run appears in `events.jsonl` in order; test replays a run and reconstructs final state from events alone, matching `run.json` (logical match of fields like `tickets`, `pools`, `done`, `report`, excluding timestamps like `startedAt`/`updatedAt`).
- [ ] Transcript files parse with `JSON.parse` per line; no `---PROMPT---` framing remains.
- [ ] `test/prosecute.test.mjs` is updated to expect JSONL framing instead of legacy framing.
- [ ] Schemas documented; `npm test` green.

title: [P2] feat: full-screen node TUI dashboard reading run.json + events.jsonl
body:
**Priority:** P2 — big bet
**Lane:** new module/package; reads only the file contracts. **Depends on:** events.jsonl issue (required), `--watch` (supersedes its rendering, keep the flag).

## Context

With atomic `run.json` snapshots + `events.jsonl`, a full-screen dashboard needs zero scheduler coupling — it is purely a reader of `.booster/` files. Per project direction, this should be **Node/npm-centric**.

## Task

Implement **Option 1**: zero-dep ANSI TUI inside agb (`agb tui /repo`, or auto-upgrade of `status --watch` when stdout is a TTY). Alt-screen, panes: ticket table (phase/strikes/model), pool gauges (inFlight/caps/requests), event timeline tail, selected-ticket transcript tail. Keys: ↑/↓ select ticket, enter toggle transcript pane (hides or shows the transcript pane visibility), q quit.
- `run.json` resides at `.booster/run.json` relative to the repository root. Its schema has a `tickets` object keyed by `ticketId` and a `pools` object keyed by pool name.
- Read `<runId>` from the `id` field inside `.booster/run.json` to resolve `.booster/logs/<runId>/`.
- Ensure T2 uses a line-buffered stream (e.g. `readline`) or explicitly checks for a complete newline before parsing JSON to prevent crashes on partial writes from active workers.
- T2 must intelligently read the tail end of the transcript, parsing the latest events and heavily truncating the massive `prompt`/`output` fields before ANSI formatting to avoid memory/CPU collapse and UI freezing.
- In snapshot-only mode (when `events.jsonl` is absent), render an empty timeline pane; transcripts can still be located via the `<runId>`.
- Initially, select the first ticket in the sorted ticket table (or none if empty).
- You will export `launchTUI(repo, isWatch, intervalMs)` from `lib/tui.mjs` (this is the existing signature expected by `bin/agb.mjs`). Do not change `bin/agb.mjs` unless it already expects this exact signature.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Live run renders all panes; `done` shows final report state.
- [ ] Render functions pure and unit-tested (state → string frame); no test needs a TTY.
- [ ] Core package still has exactly one runtime dependency (the existing dependency, do not add `ink`, `react`, etc.).
